title: Overdrive ride detail response
description: The service's answer to GET /v1/rides/{rideId}[?series=true[&step=seconds]] (spec §8.3, ADR 0022): one stored ride with its summary and laps as recorded (ride-record.schema.json), without the samples. With series=true it also carries the time series, each point the mean of `stepSeconds` seconds (step= asks for it, 1 to 600, default 10; a long ride gets a longer step so that no series has more than 1200 points): power, heart rate, cadence and the workout's target power, whole numbers, null where nothing was measured in the whole step. Computed values such as the power curve are not here: see GET /v1/rides/{rideId}/metrics. Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: the laps follow each other from 0 to the ride's duration (as in the record); the four series have the same length, and with a step of stepSeconds that is the ceiling of the duration over the step.

date.description: The rider's local day of the start.
